text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 4) A desktop fused-deposition modeling (FDM) 3D printer builds a plastic

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: part layer-by-layer from filament. The system includes motion axes, an

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: extruder, a heated bed, sensors, firmware, user interface, …etc. a. Identify

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: the main inputs and outputs (Material, Energy, Signal/information). b.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Decompose the system into at least 5-7 functions. c. Draw a Functional

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Structure Diagram (FSD) showing functions and flows. d. For each function,

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: propose at least one feasible solution element. You may use TRIZ principles

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: to support brainstorming and idea generation.
